author: Juvia
body: I was just banned for "no slow down" . After I researched it I found out that it had nothing to do with what I was doing . I was using the toggle sneak mod which I'm pretty sure isnt bannable and I was banned for "no slow down" , the toggle sneak mod does not remove waiting times for stuff . Please unban me , I was not using no slow down I was using toggle sneak , a mod that is allowed on almost every server.

title: Unrightfully banned

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
C. Client Modifications
The mods listed below are strictly not allowed to use:
4. Toggle-crouch mods that allow crouching while using a Minecraft interface (inventories, menus, chat)

Unfortunately, toggle sneak is not allowed.

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Heey Cr4fty_Kill3r,

It's your responsibility to stay updated with/read the rules. It's no excuse to say "I didn't know". Although the modification is allowed on other servers, it isn't on the Avicus Network.
Right now one of your junior mods is uploading the evidence regarding your ban for "ToggleSneak".

Regards Flo/resepignev

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Good day,

There was an error on my side. Instead of a permanent ban for "NoSlowDown" it should be an temporary ban (4 days) for "ToggleSneak". Since I made a mistake, I'll reduce the length of your ban to 3 days. I'm sorry for the inconvenience.

If you have any more questions regarding your ban or avicus, you can reply to this thread. If you don't reply within 24 hours I'll assume you accept the verdict or you don't have any questions.

Regards Flo/resepignev
